newsitem.title: UK: PSBR data consistent with forecast - UK Treasury.
newsitem.headline: PSBR data consistent with forecast - UK Treasury.

text.p: Public sector borrowing requirement figures published in recent months are consistent with the government hitting its forecast of a 27 billion stg borrowing requirement for 1996-7, the Treasury said.
The Treasury said the August PSBR figure of 4.53 billion stg had to be set against the better than expected outturn in July.
UK AUGUST PSBR 4.53 BLN STG, PRIVATISATION RECEIPTS 436 MLN STG
UK JULY PSDR REVISED MARGINALLY TO 1.663 BLN STG FROM PREVIOUS 1.661 BLN STG
UK AUGUST CUMULATIVE PSBR 13.37 BLN STG VS 16.72 BLN STG IN AUGUST 1995
